title: Red Ants Bite
program: Louis le Prince International Short Film Competition
description: Form Narrative Premiere Status Yorkshire Country Georgia, Switzerland Year 2019 Running Time 23min Language Georgian, English Director Elene Naveriani Screenwriter George Imo Abasi, Donald Acho Nwokorie, Elene Naveriani Producer Britta Rindelaub, Thomas Reichlin Key Cast Donald Acho Nwokorie, George Imo Obasi, Magda Lebanidze, Hadizat Yola In Georgia, two stranded Nigerians, Obinna and Afame, navigate the sleeping city of Tbilisi after a long night out. However, as day breaks the true colours of their ambiguous affection begin to show. In this way, they find solace despite their hostile environment. Nebahat, a teacher in her twenties, has just been appointed to a rural village school in Anatolia. She realises that her students are hitchhiking to school on tractors or using whatever means they can find. She asks the Ministry of Education for a school bus which they provide without a driver. What can she do?
